text:
My long hair!

My long hair!


You wanted your

girl with

long hair


I have it below

my shoulders


Do you think this corner

of the guava seller


where you found me

with terror and with joy


(although you only showed

paleness and silence)


will be erased by

Los Angeles,

les Champs—Elysees?

translation.title: Song
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the remembered street corner against glamorous later geographies.
